events.title: Exact EVM scheme specified
events.detail: First committed to main as specs/scheme-exact-evm.md (commit 3e5c14a); PR #1 moved it to specs/schemes/exact/ on 2025-02-23, before the public launch.

events.title: Whitepaper and public launch
events.detail: Coinbase Developer Platform whitepaper; npm x402 0.3.0 published the same day.

events.title: First high-severity advisory
events.detail: GHSA-3j63-5h8p-gf7c for legacy resource-server packages below 0.5.2.

events.title: A2A x402 extension launched with AP2
events.detail: Google's AP2 announcement; a2a-x402 v0.1.0 released.

events.title: Cloudflare and Coinbase announce a foundation plan
events.detail: Cloudflare also proposed a deferred scheme and added x402 to its Agents SDK.

events.title: Memecoin-driven activity spike
events.detail: Nearly 500,000 transactions between 2025-10-14 and 2025-10-20 amid a wave of x402-powered memecoin launches (secondary report).

events.title: Specification v2.0 dated
events.detail: CAIP-2 networks, restructured objects, ResourceInfo, extensions.

events.title: V2 launched
events.detail: PR #705 merged and @x402/core 2.0.0 published; new header names.

events.title: Stripe machine payments preview with x402
events.detail: USDC on Base. Stripe's docs (2026-10-19) offer stablecoin payments to businesses in all US states except New York, others on request, and record each settled payment as a PaymentIntent.

events.title: Solana facilitator advisory
events.detail: GHSA-qr2g-p6q7-w82m, high severity, published by the maintainers (GitHub Advisory Database entry 2026-03-07 UTC).

events.title: Technical charter adopted
events.detail: x402 a Series of LF Projects, LLC.

events.title: Linux Foundation announces the x402 Foundation
events.detail: 22 organizations expressed intent or support.

events.title: batch-settlement scheme (formerly deferred)
events.detail: Merged with the credit-backed cloudflare:402 binding and the http-message-signatures extension.

events.title: Technical Steering Committee named
events.detail: Coinbase, Cloudflare and Stripe in TSC.md.

events.title: Foundation operational launch
events.detail: 40 member organizations, 17 Premier.

events.title: Client spend controls
events.detail: @x402/core 2.23.0: spendControls with a $1 default per payment.

events.title: exact on Lightning (lnbtc)
events.detail: Specification only: no SDK implemented the binding by 2026-10-19.

events.title: Cloudflare Monetization Gateway closed beta
events.detail: Settles USDC on Base through Coinbase's facilitator; closed beta for eligible US-based sellers and buyers.

events.title: Executive Director appointed
events.detail: The Linux Foundation named Michael Hursta Executive Director of the x402 Foundation. A Governing Board handles budget and business oversight; the TSC makes technical decisions.

events.title: HEAD payment bypass fixed on main
events.detail: PR #3796 makes HEAD requests to GET-only paid routes require payment in TypeScript, legacy x402, Go and Python. Not in a published release on 2026-10-19.

events.title: Bazaar metadata content policy
events.detail: The CDP Bazaar stops listing resources whose metadata poses a prompt-injection risk and removes listed ones that fail screening, curated endpoints included.

events.title: Security reporting moves to the foundation
events.detail: SECURITY.md now sends sensitive reports privately to a TSC member or primary maintainer through the x402 Slack and non-sensitive bugs to GitHub Issues; a bug bounty is announced as coming soon.
